description: Microsoft Teams HITL approval gate. Slack analog — same asset + sensor shape, same JSON token format, composes with HumanApprovalGateComponent via shared `approval_dir`. Uses MS Graph API (Azure AD app registration with application permissions ChannelMessage.Read.All + ChannelMessage.Send + admin consent). Two approval modes: `reactions` (default; approvers react with a built-in Teams emoji — like/heart/laugh/surprised/sad/angry, limited to 6) OR `reply` (approvers post a thread reply containing a configured keyword like APPROVE/REJECT — more flexible, allows context in the same message). Multi-approver quorum + allowlist + timeout policies (escalate / reject / approve). Sensor polls Teams API every `poll_interval_seconds` and writes the standard JSON approval token on quorum. Works without a public webhook (unlike Teams Adaptive Card interactive buttons) — deployable to Dagster+ Serverless with no infra changes.

inputs.description: Upstream asset's text is posted to Teams for approval.

outputs.description: One `{asset_name}_posted` asset (records the Teams message ID + sidecar state) + one `{asset_name}_watcher` sensor (polls votes + writes the approval token on quorum).

approval_dir.label: Approval Dir
approval_dir.description: Shared with HumanApprovalGateComponent — token file lands as `{safe_partition_key}.json`. Accepts local paths (`/tmp/approvals`) OR cloud URIs (`s3://bucket/prefix`, `gs://bucket/prefix`, `abfs://...`). Cloud URIs require the matching fsspec driver (`s3fs` / `gcsfs` / `adlfs`) — required for Dagster+ Serverless or distributed deploys where the local filesystem isn't shared across containers.

approver_allowlist.label: Approver Allowlist
approver_allowlist.description: Azure AD object IDs (GUIDs) allowed to vote.
